rca_of_issue: UI automation blocker RCA: Expo web ImagePicker trigger did not emit Playwright filechooser event and did not render an input[type=file] in DOM after choose-photo-btn click. Reproduced in two scripts. This prevented automated file injection, so upload/bulk UI flows could not be completed in this headless environment even though backend upload logs show healthy processing for API-driven tests.
